controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:55.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:55.500Z"
| WHERE host.name == "db-1"
| STATS earliest = MIN(@timestamp),
        latest = MAX(@timestamp),
        total = COUNT(*)
        BY process.name
| SORT total DESC
